description: This file declares the DoorBell class and its nested Connector class, which are part of the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It defines the interface for a doorbell mechanism involving network socket communication, event signaling, and resource management.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a doorbell mechanism with methods to ring, acknowledge, wait, and manage connections.

classes.name: Connector
classes.description: A nested class within DoorBell that manages network resource binding, unbinding, and signaling for the doorbell.

methods.name: DoorBell(const TCHAR sourceName[])
methods.description: Constructor for the DoorBell class, initializing with a source name.

methods.name: Ring()
methods.description: Triggers the doorbell signal and notifies waiting processes.

methods.name: Acknowledge()
methods.description: Resets the doorbell signal, acknowledging the event.

methods.name: Wait(const uint32_t waitTime) const
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell event to occur within the specified timeout.

methods.name: Ringing()
methods.description: Sets the internal event to indicate the doorbell has rung.
